include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.8 电子战干扰站
// 配置：AN/ALQ-99吊舱 + "预言家"设备
//       雷达传感器（1km~44.4km探测）+ 干扰机（100W/200W）
//       自动干扰处理器
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type GROUND_JAMMER_STATION WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG

  mover WSF_SURFACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover

  // 雷达传感器
  sensor detection_radar WSF_RADAR_SENSOR
    mode default
      frame_time 5 sec
      beam 1
        azimuth_field_of_view -180 deg 180 deg
        elevation_field_of_view -10 deg 10 deg
        minimum_range 1 km
        maximum_range 55560 m            //注释写100km，实际44.4km，请确认目标值
        transmitter
          frequency 2.4 GHz
          power 1000 W
        end_transmitter
        receiver
          noise_figure 3 dB
          bandwidth 1 MHz              // 补充带宽，避免退化为-160 dBW默认值
        end_receiver
      end_beam
      reports_location
      reports_velocity
      reports_bearing
    end_mode
    on
  end_sensor

  // 预言家干扰机（地面大功率，多频段，200W）
  /*weapon prophet_jammer WSF_RF_JAMMER
    off                                 // 仿真启动时即激活
    mode_template                      // 多模式共用 transmitter 参数
      transmitter
        frequency 2.4 GHz
        bandwidth 50 MHz
        power 200 W
        antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA
      end_transmitter
    end_mode_template

    mode default
    end_mode

    // 干扰手段①：宽带压制干扰（全频段饱和压制）
    // 通过脚本选择: jammer.SelectMode("broadband_jamming")
    mode broadband_jamming
      // 宽带压制：功率谱密度平坦覆盖整个信号带宽
      // 干扰信号为正态分布，等效为加性高斯白噪声
    end_mode

    // 干扰手段②：瞄准式干扰（精确对准目标频率）
    mode spot_jamming
      // 瞄准式干扰：窄带，功率集中，对准目标通信频率
    end_mode

    // 干扰手段③：扫频式干扰（周期性扫描频段）
    mode sweep_jamming
      // 扫频干扰：在给定频段范围内周期性变化干扰频率
    end_mode

  end_weapon*/

  processor auto_jammer_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor

  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR

    script_variables
      bool uavs_detected = false;
      bool jamming_activated = false;
    end_script_variables

    // 每3秒检查无人机是否进入24海里范围
    execute at_interval_of 3 sec
    {
      WsfPlatform uav_a = WsfSimulation.FindPlatform("mission_uav_02");
      WsfPlatform uav_b = WsfSimulation.FindPlatform("mission_uav_03");

      // ★ 距离计算提升到外层，所有分支都能访问
      double dist_a_nm = 999.0;
      double dist_b_nm = 999.0;
      if (uav_a.IsValid()) dist_a_nm = PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(uav_a) / 1852.0;
      if (uav_b.IsValid()) dist_b_nm = PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(uav_b) / 1852.0;

      // --- 激活（原逻辑，只改距离变量已在外层定义）---
      if (uav_a.IsValid() && uav_b.IsValid() && !jamming_activated)
      {
        if (dist_a_nm <= 30.0 && !uavs_detected)
        {
          uavs_detected = true;
          writeln("SCENARIO: [JAMMER] DETECTION: UAV-02 detected, dist=", dist_a_nm, " nm");
        }
        if (dist_b_nm <= 30.0 && !uavs_detected)
        {
          uavs_detected = true;
          writeln("SCENARIO: [JAMMER] DETECTION: UAV-03 detected, dist=", dist_b_nm, " nm");
        }
        if (dist_a_nm <= 30.0 && uavs_detected && !jamming_activated)
        {
          WsfWeapon jammer = PLATFORM.Weapon("prophet_jammer");
          if (jammer.IsValid())
          {
            jammer.TurnOn();
            jammer.SelectMode("broadband_jamming");
            jamming_activated = true;
            writeln("SCENARIO: [JAMMER] JAMMING_ACTIVATED: Broadband jamming @ 2.4GHz, 200W");
          }
        }
      }

      // ★ 修复：干扰解除块——放在外层，独立于 jamming_activated 条件
      if (jamming_activated)
      {
        // 两架UAV都离开35nm（用>35避免频繁震荡）
        if (dist_a_nm > 35.0 && dist_b_nm > 35.0)
        {
          WsfWeapon jammer = PLATFORM.Weapon("prophet_jammer");
          if (jammer.IsValid())
          {
            jammer.SelectMode("default");   // ★ 先切回默认模式 → CurrentMode()变成"default"
            jammer.TurnOff();               // 再关闭武器
            jamming_activated = false;
            uavs_detected = false;
            writeln("SCENARIO: [JAMMER] JAMMING_DEACTIVATED: UAVs left detection range");
          }
        }
      }
    }
    end_execute

  end_processor
end_platform_type

// ────────────────────────────────────────────
// 干扰源2：空中干扰机（挂载AN/ALQ-99吊舱，部署在飞机上）
// ────────────────────────────────────────────
platform_type AIRBORNE_JAMMER_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature DRONE_SIG

  // 使用空中运动模型（动态飞行，非固定）
  mover WSF_AIR_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover

  // AN/ALQ-99吊舱（机载，100W）
  weapon alq99_jammer WSF_RF_JAMMER
    on                                 // 仿真启动时即激活
    mode_template                      // 多模式共用 transmitter 参数
      transmitter
        frequency 2.4 GHz
        bandwidth 20 MHz
        power 100 W
        antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA
      end_transmitter
    end_mode_template

    // 干扰手段①：宽带压制干扰（全频段饱和压制）
    mode broadband_jamming
    end_mode

    // 干扰手段②：瞄准式干扰（精确对准目标频率）
    mode spot_jamming
    end_mode

    // 干扰手段③：扫频式干扰（周期性扫描频段）
    mode sweep_jamming
    end_mode

    // 默认模式
    mode default
    end_mode

  end_weapon

  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor
end_platform_type
